title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
summary: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

title: Ondo Finance weighs acquisition worth up to $500 million
summary: The tokenized-assets firm is considering an acquisition valued at $250 million to $500 million as consolidation accelerates across crypto infrastructure.

title: Crypto for Advisors: Is the Clarity Act dead?
CME's Duffy warns an overlooked tax risk looms over U.S. perpetual futures
summary: CME CEO Terry Duffy said a court battle over whether perpetual futures are swaps or futures could eventually affect how the IRS taxes the contracts. Independent legal experts say the issue remains unresolved.

title: The economics behind Aave proposal to ditch 6 chains that earn loose change in revenue
summary: A governance proposal would shut deployments on Sonic, Scroll, zkSync, Metis, Soneium and Aptos, and retire 50 asset markets elsewhere. Deposits on some have fallen more than 90%.
